newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Nat Gas sees higher profit in 1996/97 yr.
newsitem.headline: Nat Gas sees higher profit in 1996/97 yr.

text.p: Natural Gas Corp chief executive officer Richard Bentley said on Wednesday he expected the company to post a better full year profit in 1996/97 than in 1995/96, as a result of greater gas sales.
"We're expecting a better result than last year," he told journalists and analysts at a briefing following the company's first half profit result.
The company recorded a profit for the year to June 30, 1996, of NZ$28.0 million, up from $22.2 million the previous year, and paid a dividend of 15 NZ cents per share (13 cents in 1994/95).
Earlier on Wednesday, Natural Gas reported a first half year profit of NZ$15.26 million, against $17.86 million in the previous corresponding period. It declared a dividend of 11 NZ cents per share.
